Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

  • Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

  • Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

  • Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

  • Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

  • Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

  • Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

  • Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen!

  • Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

  • Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

  • Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

  • Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

  • De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou!

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

  • In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd

  • Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT

  • Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses

  • Mogelijkheden voor remote support

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

The Opportunity

Lumai's optical engine only works if the electronics around it hold up. Our boards carry large FPGAs and custom ASICs, multi-gigabit links and fine-pitch packages, and they have to be laid out to tolerances that leave no room for guesswork. This role takes the designs coming out of our hardware and SI/PI teams and turns them into manufacturable, high-layer-count boards.

The Role

You will own board layout from schematic handoff to fabrication release. That covers stackups and HDI structures, controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length and phase matching, BGA breakout for large fine-pitch devices, and the full manufacturing package: Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings and fabrication notes. You will also own the footprint and symbol libraries, the design rules and the CAD standards the rest of the team works to.

What is genuinely hard about it is that the constraints are real and they conflict. Signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and mechanical requirements all land on the same square centimetres, and the fabricator's process limits decide what is actually buildable. You will be the person who turns simulation output into layout rules and who can defend a stackup to a fabricator.

By month six, you will have taken at least one board through to fabrication release, set the libraries and design rules the team works from, and be the first point of contact for our fabricators and assembly houses.

What You'll Do

  • Lay out dense, high-layer-count PCBs from schematic through to fabrication release, using constraint-driven flows.

  • Implement controlled-impedance routing, differential pair and length/phase matching, and HDI structures including microvias, via-in-pad and back-drilling.

  • Plan BGA breakout and component placement for large FPGAs, custom ASICs and fine-pitch packages, balancing SI, PI, thermal and mechanical requirements.

  • Translate SI/PI and hardware constraints into layout rules, and iterate quickly with engineers on simulation feedback.

  • Run DFM, DFA and DFT reviews, and act as the main technical contact with PCB fabricators and assembly houses.

  • Generate complete manufacturing outputs (Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings, fabrication notes) and manage design revisions.

  • Own and maintain the footprint and symbol libraries, CAD standards and design templates, compliant with IPC standards.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Extensive professional experience laying out complex, high-speed, high-layer-count boards, with a portfolio of designs that went into production.

  • Expert proficiency in Cadence Allegro, including Constraint Manager. Equivalent Altium experience will also be considered.

  • Hands-on experience with HDI technologies: microvias, via-in-pad, stacked and staggered vias, and back-drilling.

  • Proven BGA breakout and placement for large, fine-pitch devices such as FPGAs and ASICs.

  • Thorough working knowledge of IPC standards (IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-6012) and of DFM/DFA/DFT principles.

Strong preference for

  • Boards carrying 56G+ SerDes, PCIe Gen5/6 or DDR5 interfaces.

  • Working closely with SI/PI simulation engineers.

  • Rigid-flex, RF or mixed-signal layouts.

  • ECAD/MCAD collaboration on thermal and mechanical integration.

  • Experience setting up CAD standards, libraries and design templates in a growing team.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched Iris Nova, the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time, using up to 90% less energy than conventional GPU-based systems. Iris Nova, the first server in the family, is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions. Aura and Tetra will follow.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Job Title: Defence Account Director

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CCO

Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion

Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required)

___________________________________________________________________________

Help make sovereign AI operational for UK Defence

Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.

We build coding agents, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure required to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. We are also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.

Defence is a strategic priority for Cosine.

AI will change how Defence operates, from software engineering and intelligence analysis to cyber security, command and control, logistics and frontline operations. The challenge is turning advanced AI into capability that is trusted, secure, sovereign and useful in the real world.

We are looking for a Defence Account Director to help build that business.

This is not a traditional defence sales role. You will understand where Cosine can make a genuine operational difference, identify the right customers and programmes, shape credible opportunities and help turn early conversations into funded pilots, programmes and long-term customer relationships.

You will work closely with Cosine’s Defence Lead, technical teams and senior leadership. You will build relationships across the MOD, the Armed Forces, wider Government and the UK defence industry, while helping define Cosine’s position in the emerging sovereign AI market.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you’ll do

  • Build and own a prioritised Defence account and opportunity strategy.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the MOD, Front Line Commands, wider Government and defence industry.

  • Identify operational problems, programmes and capability gaps where Cosine can make a material difference.

  • Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, propositions, pilots and programmes.

  • Navigate Defence stakeholders, budgets, acquisition routes, procurement processes and decision-making structures.

  • Lead opportunities from initial conversation through demonstration, technical evaluation, commercial agreement and delivery.

  • Work with Cosine’s technical teams to create credible customer propositions without overpromising.

  • Develop relationships with primes, strategic partners and specialist technology companies where this creates a stronger route to market.

  • Maintain disciplined account planning, pipeline management, qualification and forecasting.

  • Bring structured customer and market insight back to Product, Engineering, ML and senior leadership.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

You may have served in the UK Armed Forces or worked closely with Defence in engineering, capability development, acquisition, procurement, digital transformation or technology adoption.

You may subsequently have worked in consulting, technology, industry or an advisory role. What matters is that you understand how Defence works and can turn a customer need into commercial momentum.

You should have:

  • Meaningful experience of the UK Defence ecosystem.

  • Strong existing relationships across Defence, Government or industry, and the ability to build new ones.

  • Experience introducing, acquiring or adopting complex technology.

  • The ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into actionable opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgement and comfort being accountable for pipeline, opportunities and revenue.

  • The confidence to engage with operators, engineers, procurement teams, senior civil servants, military leaders and industry executives.

  • Genuine technical curiosity and the ability to learn enough about AI to have credible conversations with technical teams and customers.

  • The resilience to work through long Defence sales cycles while maintaining urgency and focus.

  • The independence and judgement to operate in a scale-up where the playbook is still being written.

You do not need to be an AI expert when you join. You do need to be intellectually curious, technically literate and able to communicate clearly without hiding behind jargon.

___________________________________________________________________________

What success looks like

Success ultimately means winning business and building enduring customer relationships. We aim to onboard at least 10 new client logos within the Defence account over the next 12 months and increase revenues by at least 300%. We expect that growth to come through credibility, judgement, customer insight and persistence rather than transactional selling.

In your first few months, you will:

  • Build a clear view of Cosine’s Defence proposition, capabilities and priorities.

  • Establish a focused account and stakeholder map.

  • Develop relationships with priority customers and partners.

  • Identify and qualify the most promising opportunities.

  • Create a disciplined approach to account planning, pipeline and forecasting.

Over time, you will help convert those opportunities into funded demonstrations, pilots and programmes, while shaping how Cosine is understood and adopted across UK Defence.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why this role matters

Defence does not need more AI demonstrations that remain disconnected from operations.

It needs technology that can work across real missions, real systems, real security constraints and real acquisition processes.

You will help make that happen.

This is an opportunity to build Cosine’s Defence business from the ground up, with direct access to leadership and technical teams and genuine influence over our product, market strategy and customer relationships.

If you understand Defence from the inside, have strong customer instincts and want to help make sovereign AI operational, this is an opportunity to have significant impact.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why join Cosine

  • Build a strategically important business from the ground up.

  • Work at the intersection of frontier AI, Defence and national capability.

  • Sell a genuinely differentiated product into mission-critical environments.

  • Influence product direction and go-to-market strategy.

  • Work closely with a small, technically deep and ambitious team.

  • Receive meaningful early equity with genuine upside.

___________________________________________________________________________

 

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

 

What you can expect:

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

  • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

  • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

  • Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work

  • Weekly team breakfast & lunch

  • Monthly socials

  • Pension

  • High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you’re looking for a fast-moving environment, close collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for our first Revenue Operations hire: the person who owns how revenue actually works at Outpost.

Your job is to build the RevOps machine. One source of truth for pipeline. One model that turns a merchant's volume, markets and product mix into a price. One set of numbers that the CEO, the board and the commercial team all agree on. And a handover from signed contract to live merchant that never drops anything.

This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting layer. You'll sit between sales, marketing, and operations, and you'll be the only person who can see the whole revenue system at once. You'll design it, instrument it, automate it, and then run it until it's good enough to hand over.

You'll work directly with the CEO, the Chief of Staff and the founding team.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

You'll own a core function at a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, you'll see every commercial decision before it happens, and you'll build a function from scratch with real budget and real backing. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the revenue system

  • Own the CRM (Attio) end to end: object model, stage definitions, required fields, hygiene, automation

  • Build the forecasting system and operationalise it with weekly pipeline review, monthly board numbers, and quarterly planning

  • Own the GTM stack: outbound sequencing, enrichment, routing, deduplication, attribution

  • Run the pipeline agentically. Build agentic system that enrich accounts, draft follow-ups, surface stalled deals and keep the CRM clean, so the team spends its time on the conversations and not the admin. You'll design the workflows, write the prompts, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce

Analytics & performance insights

  • Own the revenue metrics that matter: GMV, ARR, take rate, win rate, sales cycle, pipeline coverage, cost of acquisition

  • Build the reporting the company runs on, and the pack investors see

  • Build the pricing and quoting model, and the deal desk discipline around it.

Operational execution

  • Own the handover from signed contract to live merchant, with operations, tax and engineering

  • Instrument time-to-live and revenue ramp, then attack both

  • Feed commercial reality back into the roadmap. You'll know which deals we lose and why before anyone else does

Build the function

  • Write the playbooks: qualification, scoping, pricing approval, renewal, expansion

  • Set the standard for what good data looks like, and hold the line on it

  • Hire behind you once the system is running

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild the pipeline in Attio so every deal has a stage definition, an owner, a close date and a modelled value, and the weekly review takes 20 minutes instead of two hours

  • Build the pricing calculator that turns a merchant's volume, market mix and product mix into a price, and retire the per-deal spreadsheet

  • Cut time from signed contract to first live transaction by half, working across operations, tax and engineering

  • Build the weekly revenue pack and the monthly investor pack, and automate the data pull behind both

  • Design the commission plan for the first commercial hires

  • Score the lead universe against our ICP and rebuild outbound targeting on top of it

  • Instrument the full funnel from LinkedIn and outbound through to closed won, and prove which channel actually pays

  • Forecast GMV by market and product, and tell the founding team where the $1BN does and doesn't come from

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 4 to 7 years in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, or GTM strategy at a high-growth fintech, payments company, or B2B SaaS

  • Has built a revenue system from zero, not inherited a mature one

  • Fluent in CRM architecture and the outbound stack. We run Attio, Instantly and Apollo, but the tool matters less than knowing how to design the model underneath it

  • Strong analytical skills — advanced Excel or Sheets, experience with BI tools

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action. You solve, you don't observe

  • Systems thinker who still does the work. You fix the broken report, then remove the reason it broke

  • Analytically strong. You can quantify a process, not just describe it

  • Strong EQ. You'll be telling experienced commercial people their data is wrong, and they need to thank you for it

  • Exceptionally hard working. You see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Curious and resourceful. You can figure anything out

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV, not vague descriptions

  • Not a reporting or BI role where you build dashboards and hand them over

  • Not a sales role, and not a sales-support role that takes instructions from account executives

  • Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most revenue operations roles inherit a system and tune it. You'll write ours.

At a company that takes on legal liability for its merchants, revenue operations is not admin. Pricing accuracy is margin. Time-to-live is retention. Forecast quality is how we decide what to build and who to hire. Get it right and the whole company moves faster, permanently.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly into leading the function, and we'll back you every step of the way.

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time.

This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth.

You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

This role will own:

  • Winning new business

  • Go-to-market strategy and execution

  • Client onboarding and implementation support

  • Account management and expansion

What you will be doing

  • Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success)

  • Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.)

  • Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue

  • Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation and launch strategies

  • Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, driving continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account

  • Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements

  • Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments

  • Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness

  • Operating with low structure and high ownership: remove friction, avoid bureaucracy, move fast

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

The Role

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery

  • Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
  • Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
  • Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
  • Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
  • Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.

Case management and coordination

  • Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
  • Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
  • Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
  • Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.

Clinical risk oversight and governance

  • Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
  • Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
  • Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
  • Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.

Clinical protocols and client enablement

  • Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
  • Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
  • Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.

Client relationship, insights and reporting

  • Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
  • Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
  • Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.

Requirements

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
  • Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
  • Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
  • Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
  • Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
  • Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
  • Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.

Desirable

  • Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
  • Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
  • Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
  • Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

    • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

    • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

    • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

    • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

    • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

    • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

    • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

    • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

    • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

    • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

    AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

    AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity.     Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

    We are looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to contribute to the development of the front-end of our visual inertial odometry (VIO) algorithmic stack.

    Who We Are

    Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma.     Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions.     • motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
    • comfortable interacting with technical and business people
    • strong communication and presentation skills
    • recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
    • familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)

    • fluent in both English and German
    • available for a minimum of 32h a week.

    • up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
    • Flexible working hours, including some home office.
    • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites.
    • If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.

{"data":[{"slug":"onboarding-lifecycle-communications-managerin-cologne-426058","company_name":"SpotmyEnergy GmbH","title":"Onboarding & Lifecycle Communications Manager:in (d/w/m)","description":"

Deine Mission

Als Onboarding & Lifecycle Communications Manager sorgst Du dafür, dass sich unsere Kund:innen ab dem Vertragsabschluss jederzeit gut informiert fühlen: Was passiert als Nächstes, was muss ich tun, wann geht es los? Du übernimmst die Staffel von Marketing und verantwortest die gesamte Kommunikation danach, per E-Mail und künftig auch in unserer App. Dein Maßstab ist einfach: Jede Frage, die Deine Kommunikation vorab beantwortet, muss unser Service-Team nicht mehr beantworten.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du verantwortest unsere Kundenkommunikation ab Vertragsabschluss: von der Vertragsbestätigung über das Onboarding und den Belieferungsstart bis in die laufende Kundenbeziehung.
  • Du strukturierst und automatisierst unsere Kommunikation in HubSpot für unterschiedliche Produktkombinationen und Vertriebskanäle.
  • Du sorgst gemeinsam mit Marketing für eine nahtlose Übergabe am Vertragsabschluss.
  • Du analysierst gemeinsam mit Customer Service und Technical Support, wo Kund:innen hängen bleiben, und machst daraus bessere Kommunikation.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jeder neue Produktlaunch ab Tag 1 die richtige Kundenkommunikation hat.
  • Du misst die Wirkung Deiner Strecken, testest Varianten und optimierst kontinuierlich.
  • Du baust mit uns die nutzerbezogene Kommunikation in der SpotmyEnergy-App auf, von den ersten Use Cases bis zur Verzahnung mit unseren E-Mails.
  • Du baust perspektivisch weitere Lifecycle-Touchpoints auf, etwa für Retention oder Reaktivierung.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in CRM-, Lifecycle- oder E-Mail-Marketing bzw. Customer Communications.
  • Du hast automatisierte Kommunikationsstrecken selbst aufgesetzt, idealerweise in HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren Tool wie Braze oder Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Du schreibst klar und verständlich und kannst auch komplexe Themen wie Smart Meter oder dynamische Tarife so erklären, dass sie bei Kund:innen ankommen.
  • Du denkst in Customer Journeys: Du fragst Dich nicht nur, was in einer Mail steht, sondern was die Kund:in in diesem Moment wissen muss.
  • Zahlen schrecken Dich nicht ab. Du erkennst in Öffnungs-, Klick- und Ticketdaten, wo etwas hakt, und leitest konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
  • Du arbeitest gern strukturiert und eigenständig und hast Spaß daran, Dich mit vielen Teams abzustimmen, von Produkt über Marketing bis zum Kundenservice.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, da unsere Kund:innen ausschließlich deutschsprachig sind.
  • Erfahrung mit Push- oder In-App-Kommunikation, A/B-Tests oder Branchenwissen aus Energie, Telko, Fintech oder Smart Home ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Unser Offer

  • Mission & Impact: Werde Teil eines missionsorientierten Start-ups, das die Energiewende aktiv vorantreibt und echten Unterschied macht.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hilfst dabei SpotmyEnergy auf das nächste Level zu heben – mit viel Freiheit für eigene Ideen und Formate.
  • Lern- & Wachstumskurve: Von Strategie bis Umsetzung – hier bekommst du die volle Bandbreite und die Chance, dich persönlich und fachlich stark weiterzuentwickeln. Jährl. Weiterbildungsbudget udn regelmäßige Feedbackcycles.
  • Spot Spirit: Ein motiviertes, wertschätzendes Team mit kurzen Wegen, offener Kommunikation und Events, die uns zusammenschweißen.

Your mission

We're looking for a Senior Conversion Design Analyst who is genuinely both things: a designer who digs into data, and an analyst who designs. You decide with evidence. You will frame real user problems based on qualitative and quantitative data, design a part of our product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and analyze the results yourself.

You will sit inside the product delivery team that focuses on user growth, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it. And you will not be doing it alone: You join a group of Conversion Design Analysts across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: You will be designing flows that German-speaking users read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences grounded in real user needs and real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that are highly usable and intuitive and that earn their place by adding measurable value, not just because we can build them.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Dig into quantitative and qualitative data until you find the actual question underneath the ask. Then make it explainable and actionable. A well-framed problem is half the battle
  • Design, run the experiment, read it honestly and decide what comes next. Define a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome. Then use what you learned to frame the next question. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, and designing the next step.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

  • You have statistical literacy. You don’t need to be able to run R, but you understand what Bayesian vs. frequentist is about and why you do a power analysis before launching an experiment.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • You are fluent with AI tools. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Mission

We are looking for an ambitious, curious and resilient business builder to join our global NextGen BDR Programme.

In this role, you will learn the payments craft and work with ambitious merchants and global brands, using data, technology and AI to work smarter and create high-intent opportunities for Sales.

You will take real responsibility from the start, supported by experienced Sales leaders, coaching and a strong cohort community. This is one global programme, activated locally, with a clear platform to build a long-term commercial career.

What You’ll Do

  • Master the payments craft: Build a deep understanding of Checkout.com’s products, the payments ecosystem and global payment trends so you can speak credibly with prospective merchants.

  • Research strategic accounts: Conduct detailed research into organisations, industries, stakeholders and competitive landscapes to identify high-value opportunities.

  • Create relevant conversations: Use thoughtful, creative and personalised outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn and other appropriate channels to open doors with the right decision-makers.

  • Drive growth momentum: Build a consistent operating rhythm across prospecting, follow-up, discovery and pipeline management, generating qualified meetings and opportunities for Sales.

  • Run advanced discovery: Move beyond the pitch to understand the merchant’s technical and business challenges, priorities and potential outcomes.

  • Partner with Sales: Work closely with Sales representatives to progress opportunities, maintain momentum and support the commercial lifecycle through to successful financial go-live.

  • Work cross-functionally: Partner with Solutions Engineering, Underwriting, Product, Marketing and other teams to align around merchant needs and accelerate the sales cycle.

  • Leverage AI and sales technology: Use Salesforce, intent data, enrichment tools, analytics and approved AI tools to improve research, personalisation, territory planning and pipeline accuracy.

  • Operate with rigour: Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date, apply qualification frameworks thoughtfully and use data to understand what is working and where to improve.

  • Learn and contribute: Take part in cohort learning, enablement and community activities, share what you learn and contribute to a supportive, high-standard team environment.

What You Bring

  • Hunger and drive: You set ambitious goals, work hard and keep going when the work becomes difficult.

  • Commercial curiosity: You are interested in merchants, payments, fintech and how businesses create value. You ask sharp questions and connect product capabilities to customer outcomes.

  • Learning velocity: You learn unfamiliar concepts quickly, apply feedback and improve between attempts.

  • Resilience and ownership: You recover from setbacks, take responsibility for outcomes and follow through without needing to be chased.

  • Analytical ability: You are comfortable with numbers, information and data. You can break down complex problems and use evidence to decide what to do next.

  • Communication and presence: You listen carefully and communicate clearly in writing, conversation and presentations.

  • Technical curiosity: You are interested in technology and motivated to use AI and sales tools to work smarter, not just harder.

  • Coachability: You actively seek feedback and turn coaching into changed behaviour.

  • Team impact: You believe in winning as a team, share information generously and collaborate respectfully across functions.

Requirements

  • The programme is designed for graduates and early-career builders. Previous BDR, sales or commercial experience is helpful, but not essential.

  • You can demonstrate drive, ownership, resilience or achievement through professional, academic, entrepreneurial, sporting, community or personal experiences.

  • You have a genuine interest in building a long-term commercial career and are motivated to progress beyond the BDR role over time.

  • You are comfortable with a role that includes high-volume outreach, repetition, rejection and consistent follow-through.

  • You are willing to learn complex products, use data and technology, and maintain high standards of CRM and operational discipline.

  • You have strong written and verbal English. Additional local language requirements may apply depending on the market.

  • You have the right to work in the location for which you are applying. Local working patterns, assessment arrangements and employment requirements will vary by market.

  • We welcome applicants who speak different languages and are open to relocating to Europe.

Want to Stand Out?

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

  • Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

  • When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

Remote | United Kingdom | Crypto & Payments | FCA Authorisation | Employment or B2B

Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

What you will own

  • FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.

  • UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.

  • FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.

  • UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.

  • Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

  • International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.

  • Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.

  • UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.

  • UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.

What we are looking for

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.

  • Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.

  • Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.

  • Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.

  • Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.

  • A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.

  • Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.

  • Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.

  • Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.

  • Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard.

  • Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required.

Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.

Nice to have

  • Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.

  • Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.

  • Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.

  • SM&CR experience.

  • Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments.

      Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

      Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

      À propos de l'opportunité

      Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

      En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

      Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

      Vos missions

      • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

      • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

      • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

      • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

      • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

      • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

      • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

      • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

      • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

      Ce que nous recherchons

      Indispensable

      • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

      • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

      • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

      • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

      • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

      • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

      • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

      • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

      • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

      Atouts

      • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

      • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

      Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

      Rémunération

      Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

      Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

      • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

      • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

      • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

      • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

      • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

      • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

      • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

      • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

      • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering.       Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

      The Role

      We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

      From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen.       • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

      • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

      • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

      • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

Title: Veterans Benefits Paralegal
Status: Full-time
Location: Remote
Salary: Salary to be discussed by Bryant Staffing Solutions Recruiter
Sponsorship: Not Available

Veterans Benefits Paralegal

An established legal practice is seeking an experienced Veterans Benefits Paralegal to support attorneys and senior legal professionals in representing veterans through the VA disability claims and appeals process. This role is ideal for someone with direct experience handling Veterans Disability cases who is passionate about helping clients navigate complex benefits matters.

Responsibilities

  • Review client records and conduct legal research to support case preparation.
  • Work with clients to complete required forms, authorizations, and releases for medical, military, and Social Security records.
  • Prepare and file VA claims, appeals, and supporting correspondence.
  • Guide clients through the VA benefits process and answer questions regarding their claims.
  • Manage a high-volume caseload while meeting filing deadlines and maintaining consistent client communication.
  • Review VA decisions and verify that all required documentation is maintained within client files.
  • Maintain accurate electronic case records using a case management system.
  • Provide professional, compassionate support throughout the claims and appeals process.

Work Schedule

  • Full-time
  • Monday through Friday
  • 8:30 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  • Remote candidates may work from anywhere within the United States with reliable high-speed internet access, or work onsite in Raleigh, North Carolina.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of paralegal experience handling Veterans Disability cases.
  • Candidates without direct Veterans Disability case experience will not be considered.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting strict deadlines.
  • High level of attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using Neos Case Management or similar legal case management software.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced legal environment with high-volume caseloads.

Key Skills Required

  • Veterans Disability claims and appeals
  • Case management
  • Legal document preparation
  • Client communication
  • Records and evidence collection
  • Time management
  • Attention to detail

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Profit sharing
  • Travel reimbursement

Why This Location?

North Carolina offers a high quality of life with access to beaches, mountains, vibrant cities, and outdoor recreation. Residents enjoy a growing dining and entertainment scene, rich cultural attractions, and a relatively affordable cost of living compared to many other regions. Description

Services Account Executive

Location: US / Canada (Eastern Time) - Home based

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

Job Summary

AllCloud is seeking an Services Account Executive to support the sale of professional services associated with the Salesforce platform. In this role, you will generate new business opportunities through proactive prospecting, and you will partner closely with senior Account Executives to help develop and grow existing client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career sales professional to build a foundation in consultative, solution-based selling within a fast-growing cloud services practice, while receiving direct mentorship from experienced enterprise sellers.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Growth:

  • Strategic Account Support: Support the growth of key strategic accounts — building relationships with business stakeholders, contributing to long-term Salesforce roadmaps, and helping identify Statements of Work for professional services and managed services engagements.
  • Account Roadmaps: Learn to build and extend multi-year Salesforce roadmaps that incorporate new Clouds, and help surface cross-sell opportunities for the AWS and Data & AI (Platforms) team.
  • Quarterly Business Reviews: Prepare and, over time, independently deliver QBRs — owning the agenda, deck, pre-read, and follow-up.
  • Executive Alignment Calls: Help set up and run recurring executive alignment calls, working closely with Project Managers and delivery leadership.

Sales Development & Pipeline:

  • Prospecting & Lead Generation: Generate net-new pipeline through LinkedIn social selling, Salesforce channel introductions, industry events, and targeted outreach.
  • Deal & SOW Support: Learn AllCloud's scoping and SOW process end-to-end — helping to scope, price, and advance deals under mentorship, with the goal of doing so independently.
  • Whitespace & Expansion: Identify expansion opportunities within the existing account base and build whitespace analyses for key accounts.
  • CRM Hygiene: Keep Salesforce accurate and current — opportunities, contacts, pipeline, and forecasts updated weekly.

Channel, Delivery & Thought Leadership

  • Salesforce Channel Relationships: Build and maintain relationships with Salesforce Account Directors, communicate account updates, and help identify co-sell and whitespace opportunities.
  • Delivery Coordination: Work effectively with Project Managers and Solution Architects to manage account health, prepare for executive reviews, and navigate delivery escalations.
  • Thought Leadership: Develop points of view relevant to target verticals, contribute to blog posts, LinkedIn content, and case studies, and represent AllCloud credibly at ecosystem events.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree: A degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Finance, or a related field is preferred.

Experience

  • 1-3 years of entry-level professional experience, internships, or a background in basic sales, client support, or lead generation.
  • Proven ability to assist senior Account Executives with research, client presentations, and managing smaller accounts.

Core Skills

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to pitch services and engage with clients.
  • Platform Knowledge: Understanding of the Salesforce platform's capabilities, with some experience positioning Salesforce solutions to solve business challenges across sales, service, and marketing.
  • Organization: Strong time-management skills to track client meetings, follow-ups, and sales pipelines.
  • Interpersonal Skills: A customer-oriented, proactive, and resilient personality.

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development.
