The Associate Director, US Oncology Payer Market Access will work closely with cross functional teams, alliance partners, agency partners, internal brand colleagues, promotions, internal communications, pricing, policy, legal, health economics outcomes research, and Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement teams to inform the strategies to support the alliances and our product, including current indications and future launches. This role will report to the Director, Oncology Market Access – Orals & Alliances


The Associate Director, US Oncology Payer/Market Access will be responsible for supporting Brand products tactical execution and development of strategy in support of oncology medicines, including collaborations with outside pharmaceutical partners in oncology and critical internal functions (Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement, Marketing, Integrated Account Management Teams, Center for Observational and Real-world Evidence (CORE), Medical Affairs, etc.). This role will support one of our alliance products and one new product. This role will focus on collaborating with brand teams, internal and partner alliance market access and related functions, agency partners and focus on customer segments (e.g. health plans, Medicare, Medicaid, federal, pharmacy, hospital, GPO, etc.). It will also manage early access planning for our product, contributing to projects on list pricing, lifecycle gross to net, discount/contracting assumptions, IRA legislation impacts, site of care considerations, and value messaging for payers and providers.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Work closely with alliance partners, our Company's internal functions (promotions, communications, medical affairs, brand marketing, etc.) and external agency partners to develop customer specific strategies and execute as appropriate to achieve access for patients and achieve business growth.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and alliance partners to support development of comprehensive payer/ market access strategies and execute across the partnership and for oncology medicines. This is related to current and future indications and must be aligned to the brand marketing objectives.
  • Input into development and execution of payer value propositions, channel specific strategies and branded promotional initiatives.
  • Act as main point responsible and accountable for resource support, on-going planning around messaging, and communications for field facing teams at our Company (e.g. Oncology Sales Teams, Key Accounts, etc.)
  • Provide input from US perspective into Global Access Teams, new product planning teams, Health Economics and Outcomes Research and business development opportunities as they emerge.
  • Work cross-functionally within our Company, including Organized Customer Access and Reimbursement, Market Research, policy team, Global Market Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research , compliance, legal, pricing and others to understand build a value proposition for collaboration oncology medicines that allow for access and reimbursement that is consistent with label.
  • Support alliance and new product forecasting discussions as necessary
  • Understand impact of costs on patient including OOP associated with mono and combo therapies, within both pharmacy and medical benefits.

Education Minimum Requirements

  • Required: Bachelor's degree (BA/BS)
  • Preferred: Master's degree (MBA)

Required Experience and Skills

  • Minimum of (5) years combined experience in Pharmaceutical Marketing, Marketing Customer Management, Managed Care or Sales
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, problem solving, analytical critical thinking and planning skills.
  • Proactive nature and ability to manage change, anticipate risks, and design controls or mitigation
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Proficient at leading across department and roles and effectively engaging senior management.
  • Strong judgment, prioritization, and decision - making skills, with understanding of broader context of corporate strategies
  • Comfort and confidence in working with teams and backgrounds; routinely demonstrates inclusive behaviors; actively seeks out perspectives and experiences
  • Demonstrated understanding of healthcare trends and policy issues around both pharmacy and medical benefits and their potential impact upon the company's business opportunities.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Associate Director level of Marketing or Managed Care/Payer Marketing experience
  • Experience in Oncology/Oncology Payer/ Market access for oral oncology medicines
  • Experience working in alliances and collaborations with external partners
  • Digital promotion experience

Position location: Upper Gwynedd, PA (Hybrid work model) OR Remote

ABOUT ROCKET MONEY 🔮

Financial security shouldn’t be a privilege. Yet, Americans carry $1.26 trillion in credit card debt¹, nearly one in four has no emergency savings², and only 46% of households reported retirement-account savings³. Rocket Money's mission is to meaningfully improve people's financial prosperity for millions of people.

Few companies combine Rocket Money’s reach, member trust, and understanding of people’s financial lives. Our vision: money that works for you, without making you work for it. With advances in automation and AI, we can go beyond helping members understand their finances to helping them improve their financial health, paying down debt, saving and growing their money automatically.⁠

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to build a new investing product from 0→1, then grow and scale it into a core part of Rocket Money’s future. With end-to-end ownership and direct access to senior leadership, you’ll have the reach of an established platform, the impact of a small team, and the opportunity to improve millions of financial lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE 🤹‍♀️

You’ll lead a small, decisive product team with engineering and UX to build a new investing product from 0→1, find product-market fit, and grow it into a sustainable part of our business. Together, you’ll uncover meaningful member needs, test the hardest assumptions, and build a simple, trustworthy experience. You’ll shape product direction, make clear prioritization decisions, and own outcomes from discovery through launch and scale.

The opportunity goes beyond launching another product: you’ll help make Rocket Money a place members turn to not just to manage today’s finances, but to build their financial future. What you build will give members new reasons to stay and grow with us, and help shape Rocket Money’s next chapter.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Group Product Manager, Financial Products, with close partnership with the Vice President of Financial Products and senior leadership. You’ll collaborate with engineering, design, data, operations, marketing, finance, legal, compliance, and external financial partners. You’ll pair strategic judgment with hands-on execution—from roadmap and discovery to integrations and activation and retention analysis. Success means building a product members value and a business that grows, not simply shipping features.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🛠️

Find the Right Problem and Define the Strategy 🎯

  • Build a deep understanding of our members' financial lives, goals, and unmet needs through customer research, behavioral data, and market insights
  • Define who we're building for first, why they'll choose Rocket Money, and how the product fits into their broader financial journey
  • Develop an evidence-backed product strategy, clear priorities, and what not to build

Build and Launch a New Product 🚀

  • Define a focused MVP and lead development from discovery and prototyping through launch; make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, scope, quality, and risk
  • Partner with design and engineering to test the riskiest assumptions before committing to a full build
  • Shape the end-to-end member experience, from discovering the product and getting started to using it regularly and understanding its value
  • Work with operations, marketing, and support to make launch readiness more than a release date: clear education, reliable workflows, and phased rollout

Own the Financial Product Experience End-to-End 🤝

  • Work as a product trio with engineering and UX to identify meaningful customer problems, test solutions, and build great products. Bring an end-to-end ownership mindset—from discovery through launch and iteration—with accountability for quality and outcomes
  • Work with cross-functional partners and senior leadership across design, engineering, marketing, fraud, operations, and legal to turn complex financial workflows into simple experiences, making day-to-day decisions about scope, behavior, and trade-offs

Grow and Scale the Product 📈

  • Own outcomes beyond launch: activation, engagement, retention, and business growth; define measures that reflect genuine member value, not just usage
  • Identify the biggest barriers to adoption and ongoing value; partner with design, engineering, marketing, and lifecycle teams to test and scale improvements
  • Instrument the experience, analyze funnels and cohorts, and combine experiments with qualitative feedback to decide what to improve, scale, or stop
  • Keep the team and leadership aligned on what we're learning, what is changing, and why

ABOUT YOU 🦄

About Ancestry:

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

Ancestry seeks a part-time contractor Content Writer who is passionate about family history and storytelling to join our Contextual Content team. The Contextual Content team works to bring pioneering technology, historical records, and curated contextual content together in order to empower others in researching and telling their story.

As a Content Writer you will work closely with the Editor and Program Manager in a collaborative process to complete writing assignments for the Contextual Content team. A critical element of success for this position is ensuring that the tone and style of the final product is aligned with Ancestry’s standards. This position is also responsible for managing deadlines and ensuring that they successfully deliver assignments on time.


MUST HAVE experience with Australian genealogy research and writing


Australia Subject Matter Expertise

The ideal candidate should have specialized expertise in Australian history and genealogy, including knowledge of Australian historical records, family history research, and record availability. They should also understand Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander history and records to create culturally sensitive, accurate, and informative collection descriptions that help users navigate Australian genealogy resources.

This position is a part-time contract-based and is not eligible for Ancestry benefits.

Compensation based on piece published rate ranges from $25 - $155 per piece.
What You Will Do:

  • Closely collaborate with the Editor and Program Manager to revise and develop each writing assignment to completion.
  • Conduct in-depth historical research to support each assignment.
  • Write content for several different formats, including record descriptions, stories that incorporate personalization from historical records, and blog posts.
  • Ensure each assignment follows: the style guidelines, is consistent in quality and tone, complies with department goals and values, and demonstrates audience awareness.
  • Ensure presented facts and information are supported by thorough research.
  • Consistently complete all writing assignments by submission deadlines.
  • Provide status updates and reports to the Editor and the Program Manager as requested.

Who You Are:

  • Prefer degree in history, English, journalism, or related field or equivalent professional writing experience.
  • Experience writing about historical events.
  • Experience writing about sensitive topics
  • Background in African American studies, Latin American studies, Native American studies, Asian American studies, American studies, British studies, French studies, European studies, or Australian studies.
  • Excellent writing/editing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and implement guidelines and standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to adhere to a style guide and tone.
  • Strong internet and research skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Demonstrated self-starter.
  • Background in family history.

This position is part time contract-based and is not eligible for Ancestry benefits.

About the Role: The Key Account Manager develops CMI’s transformer components business in Latin America, prioritizing Mexico and South America, and pursues selected international opportunities. The role focuses on transformer OEMs and approved commercial partners, combining new customer acquisition, strategic account management, and market development with product management responsibilities for assigned component families.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President Sales, U.S., the KAM builds market intelligence, establishes customer access, leads product qualification, and converts opportunities into profitable orders. As a product manager, the KAM translates customer needs into product priorities and works with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Marketing, and the USA/Canada Components KAM to improve and commercialize CMI’s portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a practical market-entry and growth plan for Mexico and South America. Assess transformer OEMs, demand by application, competitors, pricing, purchasing practices, and product qualification requirements.
  • Build market visibility where CMI has limited coverage. Validate accessible opportunities, identify decision-makers and routes to market, and recommend priority countries, customers, and investments using documented evidence.
  • Identify and develop relationships with transformer manufacturers, engineering and procurement teams, and selected representatives or distributors. Recommend partners and coordinate their approval, coverage, and performance expectations.
  • Lead customer qualification and approved supplier development. Coordinate technical reviews, samples, trials, documentation, and factory visits with Engineering and Quality; track approvals through first orders and repeat business.
  • Create account plans with growth opportunities, customer contacts, annual demand estimates, competitor position, qualification milestones, and next actions. Negotiate supply or framework agreements where justified.
  • Own assigned international bookings and gross-margin objectives. Lead opportunity qualification, bid strategy, customer presentations, pricing recommendations, negotiations, and commercial closure within delegated authority.
  • Coordinate complete technical and commercial quotations with Inside Sales and the components team. Obtain required approvals for discounts, contractual exceptions, and customer-specific commitments.
  • Evaluate freight, duties, currency, payment, credit, and delivery assumptions with Finance and logistics. Coordinate export requirements with the responsible specialists and ensure approved terms are reflected in the offer.
  • Validate product requirements with Engineering and delivery commitments with Operations. Support order handoff and maintain customer communication on changes, quality concerns, and recovery actions.
  • Maintain accurate opportunities, forecasts, account activity, and win/loss feedback in designated systems, using CRM when available. Report country and account performance and recommend actions to improve growth and margin.
  • Product management duties: Gather customer requirements, recommend product improvements, develop business cases, coordinate the product roadmap and launches, and monitor product sales and margin.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical sales experience.
  • At least five years of experience in technical sales, business development, or key account management for electrical equipment, transformer components, or related manufactured products.
  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English, including the ability to lead customer discussions, presentations, and negotiations and prepare clear business correspondence.
  • Experience developing business in Mexico or South America, with an understanding of regional customer relationships, buying practices, and market-entry challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to acquire customers, manage complex accounts, build market intelligence, and negotiate profitable business.
  • Ability to interpret technical customer requirements, evaluate pricing and margin, and coordinate product or application work with Engineering and manufacturing teams.
  • Strong organization, analytical judgment, communication, and collaboration skills. Proficiency in Excel and presentation tools; ability to maintain disciplined sales records and forecasts.

  • Location: Remote, US

About the job


The Rare Hematology Area Business Manager (ABM) - Hematology/Oncology will contribute to the continued growth of AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ, build markets to help patients with systemic mastocytosis (SM) and immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

This is a specialty-dedicated sales role with primary responsibility for hematology/oncology customers within the assigned territory. This individual will be a product and disease-state expert responsible for building long-term relationships with hematology/oncology physicians and account and executing against territory and business priorities.

The Area Business Manager will report to the Regional Business Director and be a key member of an efficient, effective, and highly collaborative Rare Hematology field team.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:


Territory Management & Hematology/Oncology Customer Engagement

  • Own sales execution for the hematology/oncology customer segment within the assigned territory, with responsibility for AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ performance across prioritized specialists and accounts
  • Effectively identify and engage hematologist/oncologists, and broader care team members that are key decision makers for providing treatment and conduct customer meetings within assigned territory using approved resources and messaging
  • Build relationships and manage accounts by engaging a variety of healthcare stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing, pharmacy and practice leadership.
  • Apply deep therapeutic, product, and healthcare market expertise to drive compliant customer engagement, business planning, and actionable field insights
  • Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve performance objectives
  • Lead market development within the territory by increasing disease awareness, supporting appropriate patient identification and referral, and addressing HCP educational gaps across SM and ITP patient journeys
  • Conduct formal and informal presentations and convey complex clinical information fluently to physicians in large academic centers and hospitals or large group practices/groups, in a professional, compliant, ethical and effective manner
  • Build and maintain relationships with key accounts and customers, coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders as needed to manage relationships of national and/or regional relevance

Cross-functional Execution & Business Management

  • Partner with Key Account Managers (KAMs) to align HCP-level execution with account access and pull-through priorities and overall account strategy
  • Identify and escalate institutional barriers, and support coordinated engagement at priority hospitals, health systems, IDNs, and community practices
  • Maintain effective communication with the Regional Business Director, peer ABMs, and other internal stakeholders by sharing customer insights, market trends, competitive activity, and emerging business opportunities
  • Collaborating closely with cross functional team members to address customer needs compliantly with a high sense of urgency
  • Proactively identify new opportunities and apply customer insights to develop, execute, and refine territory approaches
  • Leverage CRM, customer segmentation, sales analytics, and other approved analytical tools to understand business trends, prioritize activity, and meet target KPIs
  • Represent Sanofi at hematology/oncology congresses and local or regional professional association meetings

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • At least 5 years of pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device or life science sales experience
  • Must have a valid driver's license and willingness to travel (Field-based role)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience calling on hematologists, oncologists, and/or other relevant specialists
  • Degree preferably in Health Sciences, Business, Marketing, Accounting, or a related field
  • Sales launch experience with complex specialty products
  • Consistent success in driving above-plan sales results within a specific region or territory
  • Experience successfully promoting multiple products and balancing distinct disease-state and customer priorities within one territory is preferred
  • Understanding of disease-modifying therapies with a requisite diagnostic component and ability to navigate patient pull-through in complex market access environments
  • Adept at utilizing educational resources, data, and programs to support a positive patient and provider experience
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to form strong, trusting partnerships and drive performance
  • Robust analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and act on creative solutions
  • Ability to establish credibility, connect the dots, and align multiple stakeholders to pioneer the adoption of new products, methods, and technologies
  • A team player able to collaborate effectively with a broad range of stakeholders, gain consensus, and act independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility and the ability to plan and nimbly adapt to changing market conditions
  • Motivated by patient focus, urgency, and personal commitment to high performance, results, compliance, integrity, and an exceptional work ethic

Why choose us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

Why You?

  • Are you mission driven? At Soligent, solar is more than a job; it’s our future.
  • Do you see solutions where others see problems? You’re not satisfied with the status quo; you constantly think about how to improve processes.
  • Do you enjoy getting your hands dirty? You understand the big picture but also have an innate ability to drill down and execute with high attention to detail.
  • Can you execute individually but enjoy working with a team? We support a strong culture of teamwork where it’s about the collective gain. Feedback is a big part of that.
  • Does your word mean everything, you take responsibility for outcomes, and are incredibly persistent? We have a culture of integrity and accountability.
  • Do you connect the dots easily? You can see how your role fits in with the organization.
  • Are you fun to be around and able to wear many hats? Soligent is a fast-paced entrepreneurial culture. We believe saving the world should be fun.

As Soligent, the leading pure-play solar distributor in the US, continues to grow rapidly, we're seeking a highly skilled Customer Experience Partner (CXP) to lead and enhance our customer experience initiatives. Job Title: Rare Hematology Area Business Manager - Hematology/Oncology – Atlanta, GA

Location: Remote, US

Grade: L2-2

Hiring Manager:Maria Canterbury


About The Job:

The Rare Hematology Area Business Manager (ABM) - Hematology/Oncology will contribute to the continued growth of AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ, build markets to help patients with systemic mastocytosis (SM) and immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).


This is a specialty-dedicated sales role with primary responsibility for hematology/oncology customers within the assigned territory. This individual will be a product and disease-state expert responsible for building long-term relationships with hematology/oncology physicians and account and executing against territory and business priorities. The Area Business Manager will report to the Regional Business Director and be a key member of an efficient, effective, and highly collaborative Rare Hematology field team.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main Responsibilities:

Territory Management & Hematology/Oncology Customer Engagement


  • Own sales execution for the hematology/oncology customer segment within the assigned territory, with responsibility for AYVAKIT and WAYRILZ performance across prioritized specialists and accounts
  • Effectively identify and engage hematologist/oncologists, and broader care team members that are key decision makers for providing treatment and conduct customer meetings within assigned territory using approved resources and messaging
  • Build relationships and manage accounts by engaging a variety of healthcare stakeholders, including physicians, advanced practice providers, nursing, pharmacy and practice leadership.
  • Apply deep therapeutic, product, and healthcare market expertise to drive compliant customer engagement, business planning, and actionable field insights
  • Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve performance objectives
  • Lead market development within the territory by increasing disease awareness, supporting appropriate patient identification and referral, and addressing HCP educational gaps across SM and ITP patient journeys
  • Conduct formal and informal presentations and convey complex clinical information fluently to physicians in large academic centers and hospitals or large group practices/groups, in a professional, compliant, ethical and effective manner
  • Build and maintain relationships with key accounts and customers, coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders as needed to manage relationships of national and/or regional relevance

Cross-functional Execution & Business Management


  • Partner with Key Account Managers (KAMs) to align HCP-level execution with account access and pull-through priorities and overall account strategy
  • Identify and escalate institutional barriers, and support coordinated engagement at priority hospitals, health systems, IDNs, and community practices
  • Maintain effective communication with the Regional Business Director, peer ABMs, and other internal stakeholders by sharing customer insights, market trends, competitive activity, and emerging business opportunities
  • Collaborating closely with cross functional team members to address customer needs compliantly with a high sense of urgency
  • Proactively identify new opportunities and apply customer insights to develop, execute, and refine territory approaches
  • Leverage CRM, customer segmentation, sales analytics, and other approved analytical tools to understand business trends, prioritize activity, and meet target KPIs
  • Represent Sanofi at hematology/oncology congresses and local or regional professional association meetings

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • B.A. / B.S. degree required
  • 5+ years of experience in biotech/pharmaceutical sales calling on hematologists, oncologists, and/or other relevant specialist.
  • Must reside within or in close proximity to the assigned territory
  • Must have a valid driver's license and willingness to travel on the job (up to 50% given the field-based role)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Degree preferably in Health Sciences, Business, Marketing, Accounting, or a related field
  • 5+ years Hematology/oncology and/or rare hematology experience strongly preferred
  • Sales launch experience with complex specialty products
  • Consistent success in driving above-plan sales results within a specific region or territory
  • Experience successfully promoting multiple products and balancing distinct disease-state and customer priorities within one territory is preferred
  • Understanding of disease-modifying therapies with a requisite diagnostic component and ability to navigate patient pull-through in complex market access environments
  • Adept at utilizing educational resources, data, and programs to support a positive patient and provider experience
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to form strong, trusting partnerships and drive performance
  • Robust analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and act on creative solutions
  • Ability to establish credibility, connect the dots, and align multiple stakeholders to pioneer the adoption of new products, methods, and technologies
  • A team player able to collaborate effectively with a broad range of stakeholders, gain consensus, and act independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Flexibility and the ability to plan and nimbly adapt to changing market conditions
  • Motivated by patient focus, urgency, and personal commitment to high performance, results, compliance, integrity, and an exceptional work ethic

Why Choose Us:

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it's through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks' gender-neutral parental leave.

We are looking for a motivated Account Manager in the Asia-Pacific region who will be responsible for managing existing client accounts and generating additional revenue by working with customers on upselling, cross-selling, and retention. This is a post-sale, client-facing role, and the Account Manager is a quota-carrying contributor.
Account managers will work with a dedicated group of clients (known as their book of business) for the entirety of the client's time at Kinsta to help achieve the client’s goals and represent Kinsta in non-technical support customer interactions. Account managers are also tasked with retaining the client’s business and growing these accounts through upsells and cross-sells.
An ideal candidate is someone who is proactive and has a knack for building relationships. Also, someone who is tech-savvy, process-driven, and loves the thrill of seeking out additional revenue and closing deals!

What You Will Do:

  • Own and manage a book of business
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for clients, maintain client satisfaction, handle account upsells/cross-sells, and help clients strategize on getting the most from Kinsta’s offerings.
  • Identify the health and overall satisfaction of each account in your book of business in order to pinpoint at-risk clients and improve retention rates.
  • Spearhead a process-driven sales approach to seek additional revenue opportunities within your book of business
  • Become a specialist on Kinsta’s services and solutions, the benefits they provide, and their value to our customers.
  • Become knowledgeable about the market competition in order to retain and upsell clients.
  • Coordinate with internal Departments to resolve problems and provide service.
  • Maintain strong relationships with your book of business, including regular account reviews and communication to ensure they are deriving maximum value.
  • Develop growth strategies to increase your book of business
  • Provide timely and accurate deal updates to management and executives on a regular basis. Identify product and process improvements through conversations with clients
  • Assist other Account Managers daily to achieve team quota success.
  • Meet (or exceed!) revenue and retention targets.
  • Build, maintain, and close pipeline to consistently exceed quota.
  • Meet or exceed all of your daily and monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Position our company's capabilities and value proposition to resolve customer concerns or objections around Kinsta’s services.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date information on customers and deals within HubSpot CRM.
  • Make effective and efficient use of our sales engineers to educate customers and help them make informed buying decisions.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • A minimum of 3 years of previous SaaS Sales or Account Management experience
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple account management projects at a time while maintaining sharp attention to detail.
  • Experience up-selling, cross-selling, and renegotiating contracts
  • Tech-savvy, with a strong interest in technology.
  • Near-native proficiency in English and exceptional writing skills.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Bonus if you have:

  • Prior knowledge of the hosting industry.
  • Outbound sales experiance.

Our Benefits:

  • Flexible and remote-first environment.
  • Annual remote expense budget.

      <title>Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><span><strong>Job Title:</strong> Principal Software Engineer, AI&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Location</strong>: Remote - US</span></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.</p>
<p>This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.</li>
<li>Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.</li>
<li>Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.</li>
<li>Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.</li>
<li>Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.</li>
</ul>
<p>This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.</p>
<p>You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.</p>
<p>This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.</p>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong></p>
<p>The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.</p>
<p>The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.</li>
<li>Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.</li>
<li>A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.</li>
<li>Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.</li>
<li>Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>BENEFITS:</strong></p>
<p>For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/</p>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from&nbsp;@ <a href="http://salesloft.com">salesloft.com</a> email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official <a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p><em>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</em></p>

<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. <ul>

<li>Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.</li>
<li>Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.</li>
<li>High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.</li>
<li>Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.</li>
<li>Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.</li>
<li>Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.</li>
<li>Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.</li>
<li>A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.</li>
<li>Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.</li>
<li>Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.</li>
<li>Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.</li>

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Card Authorization</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.</li>
<li>Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.</li>
<li>Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)</li>
<li>Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity</li>
<li>Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions</li>
<li>Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.</li>
<li>Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco Bay Area (or Remote U.S.)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>
<li>You keep up with the industry trends and continuously identify new technologies to leverage to solve technical problems</li>
</ul>
<p><em><br>The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord?&nbsp;</strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Bethesda, Maryland, United States; Remote-US-MA; Remote-US-MD; Remote-US-WA; Vancouver, Washington, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.</p></div><div>
<p class="markdown-p">You'll lead the team that builds the intelligence every ZoomInfo AI agent reasons over — what's true about companies and the people in them, how they relate, and what they're buying. This role owns the B2B data graph strategy end to end, blending classical machine learning and data science with LLM and agentic systems, and treating evaluation and inference cost as core disciplines. You'll set the technical bar for a team of senior engineers while staying close to the code, shipping alongside the people you lead.</p>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You'll Do</strong></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You will ship code alongside your team, prototype alone to prove or kill an idea, and review code as a peer, setting how the team uses agentic coding tools with precise specifications and rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own delivery end-to-end, from problem framing through serving and on-call, including long-tail graph coverage and user memory for agents that separates user-supplied context from system-of-record data.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will choose the right method for each problem — classical machine learning, language models, or code — for challenges like sparse-company revenue estimation, entity resolution, and semantic intent modeling, deciding on measured evidence and stopping work that won't pay off.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will define what it takes to claim an agent's output is correct, not just that its run completed, building the evaluation datasets, regression gates, and experiment designs that back those claims.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will own inference cost, latency, and capacity, including build-versus-buy and distillation decisions, since a model too expensive to run everywhere isn't a result.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will hire and grow machine learning engineers, data scientists, and research engineers, developing senior engineers into technical leaders.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You will work across product, platform, security, and legal, and present results and their limits to executives, including when a system isn't good enough to launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><strong class="markdown-strong">What You Bring</strong></p>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Must-Have:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You have significant experience building production machine learning systems and leading the engineers who build them by shipping alongside them — demonstrated capability matters more than years.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a track record of hiring and developing senior machine learning engineers and data scientists against a high bar.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You stay hands-on today: shipping code, building prototypes independently, and using agentic coding tools daily with rigorous review.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You bring deep classical machine learning and data science expertise (supervised learning, feature engineering, statistical inference and experiment design, strong SQL) alongside production LLM and agentic systems, with the judgment to choose between them, including setting an evaluation bar with leakage-safe validation, calibration, and validated LLM judges.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have a record of cost and capacity decisions for model serving, such as moving a workload from a hosted model to a distilled or self-hosted one, with the savings measured, and you report results to executives with their limits stated, including recommending against a launch.</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p"><em class="markdown-em">Preferred:</em></p>
<ul class="markdown-ul">
<li class="markdown-li">You bring entrepreneurial experience — founding a company, or taking a product from inception to paying customers as a founding or early engineer.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience in propensity modeling, ranking and retrieval, clustering, or entity resolution at scale.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have worked on web-scale language processing over multilingual, noisy text, knowledge graphs, or user memory for agents.</li>
<li class="markdown-li">You have experience with post-training and distillation, open-weight model serving, or AI governance and safety practices (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF).</li>
</ul>
<p class="markdown-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-hybrid</p>
<p class="markdown-p">#LI-VC1</p>
</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, qualifications, skills, experience and/or training. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific salary range for your desired work location during the hiring process. We want our employees and their families to thrive.</p>
<p>In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits <a class="c-link" href="https://www.zoominfo.com/careers#benefits">here</a>.</p></div><div class="title">Below is the US base salary for this position. Additional compensation such as Bonus, Commission, Equity and other benefits may also apply.</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$233,100</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$366,300 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM) is the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform that empowers businesses to grow faster with AI-ready insights, trusted data, and advanced automation. Its solutions provide more than 35,000 companies worldwide with a complete view of their customers, making every seller their best seller.</p>
<p>ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yiG-k0YX_sW10PiJk_xliDc3W-veJCrK/view?usp=drive_link">Privacy Notice</a> for more details on how we handle your personal information.</p>

<p>ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.</p>
<p>For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.</p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. <p>In this role you will get opportunities to implement and maintain CI/CD systems and developer productivity solutions. You will be responsible for both regularly scheduled work as well as on-demand break-fix work to support Dremio’s CI/CD system, identifying areas of improvement, and implementing changes to increase efficiency and effectiveness of those systems.</p>
<p>Bring your industry experience to improve the efficiency and scale of Dremio’s infrastructure via innovation on tooling and methodologies. You should have empathy for developers and a passion for engineering productivity.&nbsp;</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio’s Query Execution team builds the runtime responsible for executing analytical queries at scale. The team sits between query planning and table scans, owning the systems that turn query plans into efficient, reliable execution.</p>
<p>As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you’ll work on query operators, expression evaluation, memory management, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and performance optimization. Your work will directly affect query performance, scalability, and reliability across Dremio’s cloud data platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build the execution engine: Design, implement, test, and support query operators, expression evaluation, execution scheduling, runtime planning, and resource management.</li>
<li>Improve runtime performance: Optimize vectorized processing, concurrency, parallelism, memory usage, data exchange, and disk spilling.</li>
<li>Diagnose difficult problems: Investigate query correctness and performance issues using query profiles, profiling tools, telemetry, benchmarks, logs, and production data.</li>
<li>Optimize Java and the JVM: Improve CPU utilization, allocation behavior, garbage collection, thread behavior, and other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the query engine: Work with Query Planner, Datalake, Product, Support, and field engineering teams on end-to-end query improvements.</li>
<li>Use AI-assisted development tools: Apply AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis.</li>
<li>Apply engineering judgment: Validate AI-generated code and recommendations through review, testing, benchmarking, and engineering judgment.</li>
<li>Raise the engineering bar: Participate in design and code reviews, contribute to technical direction, and mentor other engineers.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Software engineering experience: 5+ years developing production software, preferably in database systems, query execution, distributed systems, or related areas.</li>
<li>Programming skills: Strong Java skills; experience with C++ is a plus.</li>
<li>Computer science fundamentals: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, multithreaded programming, and asynchronous programming.</li>
<li>Database and distributed systems knowledge: Understanding of database internals, query processing, distributed execution, and performance optimization.</li>
<li>Performance engineering experience: Experience profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, garbage collection, thread behavior, or other runtime characteristics.</li>
<li>Problem-solving ability: Ability to solve ambiguous technical problems and work effectively across team boundaries.</li>
<li>Engineering judgment: Ability to evaluate tradeoffs, validate solutions rigorously, and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.</li>
<li>Communication and ownership: Strong communication skills, a sense of ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Query engines: Distributed query engines, database engines, or large-scale data processing systems.</li>
<li>Execution techniques: Vectorized execution, query operators, expression evaluation, code generation, or runtime optimization.</li>
<li>Runtime systems: JVM profiling, memory management, caching, networking, data exchange, execution scheduling, or disk spilling.</li>
<li>Data platforms: Apache Arrow, Apache Iceberg, Parquet, Avro, Spark, Hadoop, or cloud object stores.</li>
<li>Open source: Contributing to open-source projects.</li>
